name: PALE CENTURIES: Historical Life Engine
description: PALE CENTURIES offers players the choice of 340 historically grounded life scenarios spanning from 1200 CE to 2100 CE, each playable as a full 30-to-90-hour lived experience with complete sensory fidelity — the smell of a medieval tannery, the specific weight of a 20th-century factory floor, the ambient light quality of a city that no longer exists. Unlike competitors, PALE CENTURIES built its historical models with extensive consultation from diaspora cultural archives, specifically to avoid the flattening and romanticization that plagued earlier historical sims. The game's 2041-2078 'Collapse Era' scenarios are notably harrowing and deliberately unresolved.
story_hooks: A researcher using PALE CENTURIES for legitimate historical study discovers a scenario that contains details about a specific building, family, and transaction that could only have come from sealed legal records — someone with access to Meridian's buried archives helped build this game.
A Tier 1 resident who cannot afford the game receives an anonymous gift of a single scenario: their own grandmother's life, rendered in full fidelity, from a time before the Gray Zone existed.
The seventeen altered scenarios have been restored in an underground build — and the person distributing it is being hunted.
